title: Simulator Training: Approaching Thunderstorm

irb_consent.title: Training Information
text: This is a brief practice activity for learning how to use the simulator.

contact_screen.title: Contact Information
text: No contact information is collected during training.

scenario_description.title: How to Use the Simulator
text: Imagine that you are attending an outdoor community festival. A severe thunderstorm may be approaching.

At each step, open the any of the four information tiles and review the available updates. You may reopen a tile if you want to review it again. You do not have to open tiles that are not imoprtant for you in your decision making.

However, you will have to open at least one tile. After reviewing the information, select Go to Assessment. Now you can record your current level of concern and how likely you are to leave the festival.

Then choose STOP if you would leave the festival now, or NEXT STEP if you would continue monitoring the situation as it evolves. After cliching NEXT STEP the scenario advances by 30 minutes as shown by the change in time
in the upper right corner. This training ends after Step 2.

assessment_instructions: Use both sliders to show your judgment based on the information available in this practice step. Each slider ranges from 0 to 10 and begins at 5.

assessment_variables.prompt: How concerned are you about your safety right now?
How likely are you to leave the festival now?

decision_instructions: Select STOP if you would leave the festival now. Select NEXT STEP if you would continue monitoring the situation. The practice ends after Step 2 regardless of your choice.
completion_message: You have completed the practice activity. In the main scenario, review the information tiles, update the sliders, and choose whether to stop or continue when prompted.

1.text: Dark clouds are visible west of the festival. Rain may begin within the next hour.

2.text: The sky has become very dark. Strong wind and heavy rain are expected within approximately 20 minutes.

1.text: The National Weather Service has issued a severe thunderstorm watch for the area.

2.text: A severe thunderstorm warning has been issued. People outdoors are advised to seek shelter immediately.

1.text: The festival is continuing normally. Some visitors have begun checking weather updates.

2.text: Festival staff have stopped activities and are directing visitors toward exits and nearby buildings.

1.text: Your vehicle is parked about a 10-minute walk away. Roads are open and traffic is normal.

2.text: Many visitors are leaving at the same time. Pedestrian and vehicle congestion is beginning to increase.
